name: B10-0406/2026 – Recital E – Am 58
title: MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the recent hybrid attacks and instrumentalisation of migrants in Ceuta and the need for a coordinated response to protect the EU’s external borders
part_text: E. whereas Ceuta and Melilla’s borders are external borders of the EU; whereas many of those who arrived irregularly in Ceuta were reportedly victims of false information and used for political pressurisation and destabilisation; whereas some reports have highlighted allegations of Morocco’s involvement;
